info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking Facilities Site Administration By Site Administration Id-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking Facilities Site Administration Update API enables authorized users to modify existing site administration records within the banking facilities system. This endpoint allows for the patching of attributes linked to a specific site administration identified by the siteAdministrationId. Typical consumers include banking system administrators who need to update facility configurations or correct data entries. Developers can utilize this API to maintain accurate site records, ensuring operational efficiency and compliance with banking regulations.
